title: Conditional Transfer of Digital Assets via Digital Identity and Verified Credentials

ms.promise:
We use this first milestone to spend time researching the best solutions for conditional sharing of secrets via Decentralised Identity. We will review industry solutions and also check how Digital Identities can be used to offer a better alternative. 
・up to date GitHub repo
・prototypes and/or documentation and/or test scripts validating all research areas
・video recording explaining tech choices
ms.criteria:
We will deliver an initial design of a solution to implement. Choices will be narrowed down as much as possible, and technical validations of important choices will be provided. Acceptance is either of those 2 deliveries:
・Either the research leads to a final workable design (the chosen design)
・Or if no good solution: a backup plan or alternative design with a list of all potential restrictions (the alternative design)

Note: the chosen design cannot be know yet at this stage, since this is a good part of this research project

ms.report:
Hello reviewers. 
Sorry for the delay, there was a lot to do, also alongside other projects. 
I am submitting proof of achievement for M2. 
・an Identity Cloud infra (fully hosted on AWS) to provide PoC of integration with Identus. This part is not demonstrated in the video, as it would take too long, but it is here as a piece if infra, otherwise we would not be able to run the PoC on top.
・A reviewed and final design of the solution where Alice does not need a DB, and Bob does not need either. This is a significant improvement on the initial design delivered in M1. The full solution to get there is not entirely documented in the video (would have taken too long too), but you can see it in the code if you are interested, as we are using derivation encryption from Alice's Digital Identity's Private key to generate the various passcodes and the salt, for each message we have to encode.
・A full working proof of Concept written in Python (server side) and JS / HTML (client side)
・an up to date github repo (including app : https://github.com/incubiq/one_crypto_pass/blob/main/app)
・a 17min video which includes a full demo of the PoC: https://youtu.be/M4DpnHqJjOk

I hope the demo video will be self explanatory. As explained in the video, we are not implementing a sign message in a wallet, as this is outside the scope of this project, so instead we "fake" a wallet signing with a Digital Identity's private key.
Note1: as soon as you validate this M2, I will proceed to deliver the M3 which is the final deliver and final closeout report
Note2: the interpretation by the notary of the condition is also out of scope of this PoC, and could lead to very varied implementation, either checking onchain, or based on date, or many other alternatives. Those "if/then" rules can be implemented as per the need of the user. This is why for now, the Notary always accepts the condition, but also the Notary is the one who encodes the condition anyway, so if later it cannot interpret a condition,
